links.comparator_used: Applying deep learning to all slide tiles (no tissue or region-of-interest filtering)
links.outcome: Yearly CO2 eq emissions of deep learning on whole-slide images
links.effect: Combined with the 7-task scenario and small models, tissue-only slides reduced worldwide CO2 eq emissions by up to 141 times (0·1 Mt, 95% CI 0·1-0·1). Emissions across scenarios, inputs and model sizes ranged from 3·61 t to 2795·30 t per year.
links.quote: Use of the 7-task scenario and small deep-learning models on slides containing tissue only could substantially reduce CO2 eq emissions worldwide by up to 141 times (0·1 Mt, 95% CI 0·1-0·1).

design_hint: emissions reduction strategies (model pruning, tissue-only tile input, smaller models)
